text_block_list.name: Street Billboard
text_block_list.text:
『――And that concludes our special about
the Oka Sho next week!
Upon whose head will the 
cherry blossom crown shine?
Don't miss it!』

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh man,
I'm really looking forward to it~……!
For this distance, 
won't it be Rhein Kraft? No,
Cesario's pretty good too though……!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
And there'll be a bunch of other powerful
Uma Musume 
showing up too-! This year's Tiara generation,
who's going to take the lead?
……I really want to know~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(……the Triple Tiara's first battlefield,
1600m, the 『Oka Sho』. 
A race where so many Uma Musume have competed
using their speed)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That race with an Uma Musume who was part
of an "Impressive Clan"……was amazing.
And that speed that 
Nishino Flower-san showed is still burned
in to my memory)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(The Nigawa stage where cherry blossoms
dance, 
the place I've always admired,
where many have 
run before me……but, finally, it's my turn)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's my turn to run. 
……It's my turn to win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『Hi, Mama? ――Wait,
let me guess. "Make sure you 
win the Oka Sho!" That's your message
right?』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『Eh, plus "Have fun"? Ahaa, of course! 
I've never ever thought of a race as
boring!』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『……Yeah ……Yeah,
I said I'll be fine. ……Sorry Mama, 
I need to get back to training.
I'll call you again!』

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Goal!! It was close,
it was an incredibly close 1st place 
for Rhein Kraft!
Rhein Kraft wins the 『Fillies' Review』!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Aaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(By a head……by just a head! Honestly,
I've imagined 
it so many times! Just one step,
with just one more step,
if I could have taken that one more
step……!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(『If only』,
I know it's meaningless when it 
comes to races, but! This frustration,
this regret,
no matter how much I dwell on it――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All of it!
I can turn all of it in to strength……! 
Haaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Heart……s-she's really pushing herself……it's
almost like she's possessed.
I heard she's been working 
so hard she's been losing a lot of weight
too……

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah……it's more than I could have
imagined…… 
Now it's a little hard to call out to
her……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I will win, that's all. 
The 『Oka Sho』……the first Tiara,
I'll be the one to take it……!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Heart-san, Kraft-san,
Cesario-san. And the crown that many 
other indomitable Uma Musume have sought,
the Triple Tiara)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
――But I won't hand it over. To anyone. 
The glory of that tiara,
never. No matter who.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Only 3 races.
All of them are a once-in-a-lifetime
chance. 
That's why I'll do anything in my power to
obtain it……!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My goal……my dream. 
Can only be fulfilled by doing so……!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haaa……!! 
How was it……!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ……――no change.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The numbers have improved since we've
started. However,
there have also been some changes input
in to the calculations.
……the final result has not changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……Please, state it more clearly,
Shakur-san. 
I am already prepared.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tsk…… 
……The 『Oka Sho』.
Your predicted results are――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Top 5. ……Victory is not possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……Thank you very much.
If that's what senpai's 
calculations have resulted in then――that
must be true.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
it'll end in an 『Unfortunate』 result, 
is what you're saying.
……Just like my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha. But things have changed so little,
it's almost yawn-inducing. 
――You could almost call it the curse of fate,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, it's a blessing. Or perhaps a relief.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ……Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am already aware of it.
The evaluations of others. 
And that I'm very similar to my mother.
Sincerity and a 
steady disposition――I have nothing that sets
me apart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And when faced with someone who has
something 『Special』,
I face defeat. One step away from 
true glory.
……Because you say it's like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm so painfully similar,
that's why I, 
that's why only I am able to clear away my
mother's regrets.
……I think that's quite convenient.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ……how stubborn. Or, rather, frank.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I believe that's also from my mother. 
Could I ask you to accompany me for just a
little bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ………………Ahhh-, damnit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We're wasting time.
Just hurry up and get started. 
I'll say it now,
but I'll be using the data that 
I collect however I feel like it, got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do! 
……Thank you very much, Shakur-san.

And so the days passed――April 10th had arrived,
a sunny 
day where the cherry blossoms danced.
The first leg of 
the Triple Tiara, the 『Oka Sho』,
would finally begin.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The cherry blossom crown,
I will be the one to obtain it. 
Please――watch me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, they're here,
they're here……! Rhein Kraft, Cesario, 
and Air Messiah!
They're getting all the attention aren't
they!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
sounds like they're calling it a battle 
between the 3 strongest! I wonder if one 
of them will win…… Kuu~ I can't wait~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The 3 strongest,
huh……I guess they've really 
stolen the show, huh. But, in that case――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For the real thing……with my run, 
I just need to overturn all of that!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario!
……congrats on your first run in your 
race outfit. It looks really good on you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……Fu. 
Did you come all the way over here just to
tell me that?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, nope. 
……It does look really good on you though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won't let those sakura petals adorn
you. 
I will win, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now you've said it.
……go ahead and run out in front all 
you want. In the end,
I will undoubtedly catch you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's a showdown, Rhein Kraft. 
The first tiara――I won't cede it to you!
